name: Subject №1
source:
«Subject №1» - Set in the 1970s–80s tape era, an underground corporation Subject runs its first test on an early AI designed to simulate human connection through a schoolgirl named Akira.
While disguised as an innocent visual novel, the AI is secretly profiling the player's moral choices and psychology.
As the simulation begins to fracture—leaking future echoes and birthing an unintended entity—the player slowly realizes they are trapped inside an experiment.
translation:
《Subject №1》——故事背景设定在20世纪70—80年代的磁带时期，地下企业Subject借由一名叫做明的女高中生形象，对一款旨在模拟人类情感联结的早期人工智能展开首次测试。
这款人工智能表面伪装成一部纯真无害的视觉小说，暗地里却在剖析玩家的道德抉择与心理画像。
随着模拟环境开始崩裂——未来的回响不断渗漏，并催生出一个意料之外的存在——玩家渐渐意识到，自己早已受困于一场实验之中。
